extracted_factors.Label: Improper Permit Granting
extracted_factors.Description: Excessive and improper granting of coal mining permits leading to regulatory violations and environmental degradation.

extracted_factors.Label: Coal Mining Induced Land Clearing
extracted_factors.Description: Land clearing in East Kalimantan driven by coal mining operations, resulting in deforestation and habitat loss.

extracted_factors.Label: Insufficient Monitoring and Oversight
extracted_factors.Description: Lack of adequate monitoring and enforcement of mining regulations, contributing to regulatory violations and unsafe mining practices.

extracted_factors.Label: Proximity of Mines to Settlements
extracted_factors.Description: The close proximity of coal mining operations to human settlements, leading to safety hazards and conflicts.

extracted_factors.Label: Regulatory Changes and Governance
extracted_factors.Description: Frequent changes in regulatory authority concerning mining licensing and governance, leading to inconsistent enforcement.

extracted_pain_points.description: Widespread regulatory violations due to the improper granting of mining permits and insufficient enforcement.
Numerous deaths and safety risks associated with unregulated coal pit operations and their proximity to human settlements.
Significant deforestation and habitat destruction driven by coal mining expansion.
Increased conflicts and disputes between mining companies and local communities due to land use and environmental impacts.
Challenges in mining governance due to regulatory changes, corruption, and lack of resource monitoring.
